list_my_groups.description: List the groups the logged-in account belongs to, from facebook.com/groups/joins.

maxGroups.description: Maximum number of groups to return. Defaults to 50, capped at 200.

get_group_posts.description: Extract posts from the group feed currently open in the tab. Scrolls to load the virtualized feed.

maxPosts.description: Maximum number of posts to extract. Defaults to 20, capped at 100.

scrollRounds.description: How many times to scroll the virtualized feed before extracting. Defaults to 3, capped at 15.

returns.description: Array of {author, authorUrl, text, permalink, timestamp, timestampAbsolute} objects. author and text are always populated; permalink and both timestamps are empty for roughly half of posts because Facebook never renders their timestamp anchor.

post_to_group.description: Open the group composer and type a post. Only submits when confirm is true; otherwise it leaves the filled draft on screen for review.

text.description: Post body to type into the composer.

confirm.description: Set true to actually publish. Defaults to false, which fills the draft and stops so a human can review it.

submitLabels.description: Extra aria-label strings for the publish button, for UI locales beyond the built-in English and Hungarian defaults.

returns.description: { status, draft, url } where status is 'posted', 'drafted', or 'failed'. The drafted result also carries matchesRequested, which is false when the composer altered the text — Facebook drops a trailing period.

composer_state.description: Report whether a post composer is open on the current page, what it contains, and which publish button is reachable.

returns.description: { open, text, submitLabel, submitEnabled } describing the composer.
